name: local-commander-mcp-agent
description: Files, Git, allowlisted developer commands, dev processes and localhost inside folders you choose.
long_description: Local Commander gives the AI controlled access to chosen project folders: bounded file reads and edits, Git status/diff/log, allowlisted developer commands (git, node, npm, python and similar, never a free-form shell), long-running dev processes and localhost HTTP. Secret files such as .env and private keys are blocked by default. No telemetry.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders Local Commander may read, edit and run commands in.
